Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/behavior_policy.py

src/agent_runtime/behavior_policy.py

Python · Tier A

Capture task approach independently of model sampling and execution authority. Typed presets guide research, planning, dependencies, verification and evidence; retained snapshots survive later preset changes. Guidance projection and per-family result streaks provide bounded recovery hints without changing receipts, retry limits or completion truth. Runtime guidance strings remain source-owned prompt inputs and are preserved verbatim.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ResearchPolicy 38 Captured research intensity, timing of local investigation and Web escalation, plus source- quality preference. These values select model guidance; they do not enable Web tools or perform searches.
RecoveryPolicy 48 Bound the unsuccessful-attempt count that adds recovery guidance and retain the stop-guessing preference. This is feedback policy, not the execution retry limit or a deterministic stop condition.
DependencyPolicy 56 Guide reuse of installed tools and the justification expected before adding dependencies. The compatibility vocabulary includes historical postures; installation permission still belongs to execution authority.
VerificationPolicy 70 Select guidance for ordinary writes and critical actions independently. These effort levels do not rewrite receipt facts or replace the completion verifier.
ToolStrategyPolicy 77 Capture the preference for structured tools without changing their availability, capability selection or authorization.
PlanningPolicy 83 Capture the amount of planning guidance appropriate to the task effort. It does not alter scheduler ownership or create a task plan by itself.
EvidencePolicy 89 Capture how strongly guidance asks for corroboration of material claims. This descriptive effort remains separate from required completion evidence and tool receipts.
AgentBehaviorPolicy 102 Version-one accepted behavior snapshot combining effort and all approach dimensions, with verified-current-context reuse required at every effort. Saved snapshots govern retained work independently of later source preset changes.
AgentBehaviorPolicy.exact_version 110 Require the exact integer schema version 1 before model validation; boolean or coerced versions cannot be accepted as compatible snapshots.
AgentBehaviorPolicy.exact_reuse_invariant 130 Require literal True for verified-context reuse so no effort level or malformed snapshot silently disables this invariant.
normalize_behavior_effort 202 Validate one of the five canonical effort names, using the caller's default only for None. Unknown values raise rather than being rounded or mapped to inference settings.
resolve_behavior_policy 209 Expand a validated effort into the source-controlled preset and return a complete strict policy. This is for new acceptance; callers restoring existing work must validate its captured snapshot instead of recomputing the preset.
apply_behavior_policy 235 Apply a trusted explicit or context snapshot, otherwise resolve a new preset, and reject disagreement with an explicitly supplied effort. Write the canonical effort and JSON-compatible snapshot into mutable context without changing client sampling, tool authority or storage.
behavior_projection 276 Return stable base guidance plus any current recovery overlay, computing the base with failure/recovery indicators cleared when it is not supplied. Identical guidance yields no overlay; outside completion recovery, omit repeated base lines when verified-context reuse is active.
behavior_task_guidance 299 Compile captured behavior dimensions into source-owned model guidance and optional per-family recovery feedback. Use default policy only when the state lacks one, and report threshold- crossing categories from retained streaks. This function neither invokes a model nor modifies evidence, authorization, sampling or execution state.
behavior_attempt_outcome 672 Classify operation metadata as progress, unsuccessful or neutral for guidance only. Waits, approval/credential needs and uncertain/cancelled effects remain neutral; negative HTTP observations and proven failed process outcomes may suggest recovery. Do not scan arbitrary output for failure prose or turn this hint into receipt/task truth.
record_behavior_result 733 Update only the relevant operation family's failure streak, preserving other families and skipping neutral/completion-recovery observations. Return a feedback event exactly when that family reaches its captured threshold; success resets that family's counter. The caller owns persistence and event publication, and no tool is retried or task stopped here.
